title: Wish & If Only
completion_message: ¡Excelente! 'Wish' y 'If Only' son estructuras sofisticadas para expresar arrepentimientos pasados, deseos de cambiar el presente o quejas sobre el comportamiento de otros.

parts.visual:
1. Deseos sobre el PRESENTE (Situaciones irreales ahora): 
Estructura: Wish / If only + Past Simple. 
Ej: I wish I HAD more time. (Ojalá tuviera más tiempo). 
Ej: If only he KNEW the truth. (Si tan solo él supiera la verdad). 
*Nota: Con el verbo To Be, se usa 'were' para todas las personas. 
Ej: I wish I WERE the boss.
parts.audio: Wishes about the present. To express a desire to change a present situation, use 'Wish' or 'If only' plus the Past Simple. For example: I wish I had more time. Or: If only he knew the truth. Note that with the verb To Be, we use 'were' for all subjects. For example: I wish I were the boss.

parts.visual:
2. Arrepentimientos del PASADO (Lamentar algo que ya ocurrió): 
Estructura: Wish / If only + Past Perfect. 
Ej: I wish I HAD BOUGHT that stock. (Ojalá hubiera comprado esa acción). 
3. Quejas sobre el comportamiento de otros (Molestias): 
Estructura: Wish / If only + would + infinitivo. 
Ej: I wish you WOULD STOP talking. (Ojalá dejaras de hablar).
parts.audio: Regrets about the past. To regret something that already happened, use 'Wish' or 'If only' plus the Past Perfect. For example: I wish I had bought that stock. For complaints about someone's behavior, use 'would' plus infinitive. For example: I wish you would stop talking. This means 'I am annoyed and I want you to change your behavior'.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta después de 'Wish' o 'If only'.

questions.question: I wish I ____ more about finance. (Ojalá supiera - presente).
questions.explanation: Deseo sobre el presente: Past Simple (knew).

questions.question: If only we ____ that contract last year. (Si tan solo hubiéramos firmado - pasado).
questions.explanation: Arrepentimiento del pasado: Past Perfect (had signed).

questions.question: I wish the manager ____ shouting at everyone! (Ojalá dejara de gritar - queja sobre comportamiento).
questions.explanation: Queja sobre alguien más: would + infinitivo.

questions.question: I wish I ____ in charge of this project. (Ojalá estuviera al mando - presente).
questions.explanation: Deseo presente con To Be: se usa 'were' (I wish I were).

questions.question: If only I ____ a backup of my files before the computer crashed! (Si tan solo hubiera hecho).
I wish it ____ raining. We can't go out. (Ojalá dejara de llover - queja sobre la situación actual/clima).
questions.explanation: Queja/deseo de cambio de comportamiento (incluso del clima): would stop.

questions.question: Do you ever wish you ____ your own business? (¿Deseas tener - presente?).
I wish I ____ that to the client. Now he is very angry. (Ojalá no le hubiera dicho).
If only they ____ us more time to finish the report! (Ojalá nos dieran - deseo presente/futuro que no depende de nosotros).
questions.explanation: Queja/Deseo sobre acción de otros: would give. (También 'gave' es posible para presente, pero 'would give' enfatiza la voluntad de ellos).

questions.question: I wish I ____ speak Japanese fluently. (Ojalá pudiera).
questions.explanation: Para habilidad en presente se usa 'could' (el pasado de can).

questions.question: She wishes she ____ to university when she was younger. (Ojalá hubiera ido).
If only I ____ a million dollars right now! (Si tan solo tuviera).
I wish you ____ me you were going to be late! (Ojalá me hubieras dicho).
I wish my computer ____ so slow. (Ojalá no fuera - presente).
questions.explanation: Presente: weren't (pasado irreal del To Be).

questions.question: I wish they ____ complaining all the time. It's annoying. (Ojalá dejaran de).
If only we ____ the map, we wouldn't be lost now. (Si tan solo hubiéramos traído).
I wish I ____ work tomorrow, but I have a lot to do. (Ojalá no tuviera que - presente).
questions.explanation: Presente/Futuro irreal: Past Simple (didn't have to).

questions.question: He wishes he ____ that expensive car last month. (Ojalá no hubiera comprado).
I wish you ____ listen to me when I am speaking! (Ojalá me escucharas - queja).
questions.explanation: Queja sobre el comportamiento de otra persona: would.

questions.question: If only I ____ the CEO of this company! (Si tan solo fuera).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo en la forma correcta después de Wish/If only.

questions.question: I wish I ____ (have) more money now. (Presente)
I wish I ____ (know) the answer. (Presente)
I wish I ____ (buy) Bitcoin in 2010. (Pasado)
If only we ____ (sign) the contract yesterday. (Pasado)
I wish you ____ (stop) doing that! (Queja con would)
I wish I ____ (be) the boss. (To be en presente irreal)
I wish he ____ (listen) to me! (Queja con would)
If only I ____ (not / say) that to her last night. (Pasado - no hubiera dicho)
I wish I ____ (can) help you. (Habilidad presente - pasado de can)
If only I ____ (live) in Paris right now. (Presente)

pairs.source: I wish I didn't have to

pairs.target: Si tan solo ella hubiera llamado (pasado)
Ojalá lloviera (deseo de cambio en el clima)
